column1: # People aliases for the Rafi canon: variant<TAB>canonical. Names are folded before matching
# (case, accents and punctuation ignored, so "Suman [?]" is read as "suman"). The canonical
# spelling is also the name the explorer shows. Add a row whenever the user corrects a name.
# Only rows that hold for Rafi's songs alone stay here (e.g. a bare first name the user resolved);
# spellings that hold in every Hindi film canon go in ../hindi-films/lexicon/people.tsv, which
# the pack lists after this file.
# HFGK's "Suman [?]" (not sure which Suman) is Suman Kalyanpur in Rafi's songs (user, 2026-11-15).
